final: WITH race_name_field AS (SELECT r.name, COUNT(ds.points) AS field_size, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(field_size) AS overall_avg_field_size FROM race_name_field) SELECT AVG(rnf.avg_points) AS average_of_average_points, AVG(rnf.field_size) AS average_field_size, AVG(rnf.field_size) - o.overall_avg_field_size AS above_overall_average FROM race_name_field rnf CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE rnf.field_size > o.overall_avg_field_size
